verdict.rationale: Copilot lets you assign tasks to multiple agents (Copilot, Claude, Codex) that run autonomously in the background. A single workspace or control page lets you track progress across agents, switch between sessions, review changes and merge completed work, which implies parallel runs you can review side by side. The evidence never says you can launch several attempts at the same task and compare their outputs to pick a winner, so that is only inferred. Missing for 10: explicit multi-attempt runs of one task, a side-by-side comparison or selection workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
